notes.title: Patch Notes [BU36/0.6.6]
notes.content:
Hello Players!

The AI update is live with new deer models, new AI behaviors, sound effects and fixes.

The focus for this update has been to improve the way that the AI works. As mentioned in the previous [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1948140/view/4188987230478872095?l=english]devlog (#4)[/url], the system was well due for a rework and through the process I have learned a lot to help with the next step of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339493/b7a0cf3c7e430604781d0a910fd6edd7533c74fc.png[/img]
Instead of generic spawning, the animals are now properly attached to their own nests. Destroying these will not only decrease your reputation, but also prevent the animals from roaming around.

The players that take the friendly route can expect different bonding experiences with the animals: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339493/ed867f08430d4f2850fb3fe447318ebd5591cfff.png[/img]
Rabbits now approach you on their own, allowing you to create your own bunny army. All you have to do is interact with them and they will forever be loyal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339493/0b48243ef1f7741ec1b17e57b6ef09afe07db2c9.png[/img]
Foxes, as skiddish as they are, will no longer ignore the player if they approach, even if the player is friendly. They will also no longer approach if you wait patiently with food. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339493/f6dc3d2d99adeabf9cb7f5c54c1adef433754d0b.png[/img]
Place down the new baits and watch from a distance. When they are ready, they will approach you on their own terms, and if you wish to befriend them you better hold something they like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339493/9e731475ef719c557eaa2cec05f9823217111520.png[/img]
Deers now pivot around their pack leader. If the leader flees, the rest of the deers will flee. If the leader is tamed, so are the rest.  

The players that take the other route can expect a visit in the night as a consequence for their behaviors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339493/fb844939cb98cfce4d7cefe1e71a4e98e6b06f37.png[/img]
And if you find yourself surrounded, a spear can come in handy to block the incoming attacks.

Below is the full overview of changes:

[u][b]New[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added a new crafting category.
[*] Added new foliage.
[*] Added fox nests.
[*] Added rabbit nests.
[*] Added boar nests.
[*] Added animal reactions to seeing the player.
[*] Added new volume sliders.
[*] Added ambient audio to occupied animal areas.
[*] Added additional SFX to all animals.
[*] Added a hit VFX when dealing damage to blueprints.
[*] Added nighttime activity for wolves and players in the red reputation zone.
[*] Added baiting.
[*] Added a new tutorial for the headlamp.
[*] Added a new tutorial for the spear.
[*] Added a new tutorial for the baits.
[*] Added an exhausted character state.
[*] Added exhausted character SFX.
[*] Added more bones to the map.
[*] Added more cheats.
[*] Added a way to pick up decorations that consist of an item by holding the interact key.
[*] Added new camera shake effect for when player is sprinting while exhausted.
[*] Added a way to block incoming damage with the spear by holding right-click.
[*] Added a way to bait animals by dropping food on the ground. Bait can also be used for taming/bonding progression.
[*] Added a deer leader.
[*] Added two new deer models.
[*] Added new bonding VFX.
[/list]

[u][b]General Changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Made adjustments to the landscape.
[*] Made adjustments to the wolf nest camp.
[*] Made adjustments to the entrances to the wolf nest.
[*] Made adjustments to the waterfall cave.
[*] Adjusted the max travel distance for the different arrow types.
[*] Adjusted medkit healing over time trigger from 10 seconds to 4.
[*] Removed destroy key (Default Key: Q). Melee weapons will now be used to destroy buildings.
[*] The large campfire is now used as a safe-zone building.
[*] The player can now always sprint, but sprinting without stamina will greatly decrease hunger, oxygen and thirst.
[*] Breaking tree trunks will no longer automatically add bark to the inventory. Bark now spawns similar to the logs.
[*] Hitting trees with the modern hatchet will now break more pieces of the tree than with the crafted hatchet.
[*] The cart tutorial now appears when first interacting with the cart and not when walking near it for the first time.
[*] Lowered the shader opacity for unfinished structures from 0.8 to 0.4.
[/list]

[u][b]Animal Changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Foxes will now only accept bait as a peace-offering from the player before it tries to approach.
[*] Foxes will flee if the player does not carry a peace-offering when it tries to approach.
[*] Foxes will flee if the player gets too close, even if the player has a green-zone reputation.
[*] Deers will flee if the player gets too close, even if the player has a green-zone reputation.
[*] Taming the leader of a pack of deers will now make all the other deers in the area tamed as well.
[*] Rabbits no longer need to be bonded with to befriend. If the player's reputation is high enough, the rabbit will approach the player on its own terms.
[*] Animals now react to arrows even if not hit.
[*] Boars and wolves now flee when damaged and the attacker is out of view.
[*] If the player's reputation is high enough, freeing rabbits will immediately befriend them.
[*] Tamed animals set to “Stay” will now wander in a radius near the first placed large campfire. 
[*] Hitting tamed animals with weapons will now cause all of them to run off.
[*] Improved AI pathing.
[/list]

[*] Fixed a bug where the bows had more inaccurate firing directions than normal.
[*] Fixed a bug where the arrow UI would move when hovering one of the icons.

[*] Fixed a bug where weather would not save.
[*] Fixed a bug where hovering over the animal beds would display wrong building requirements.
[*] Fixed a bug where it would randomly become daylight in the middle of the night.
[*] Fixed a bug where the rain effect didn’t show.
[*] Fixed a bug where it would start raining with a clear sky.
[*] Fixed a bug where the change arrow UI would appear when not holding the bow and pressing R.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could not collect certain items from the small campfire due to collision.
[*] Fixed a bug where corn could stack to 30 and burnt corn could only stack to 20.
[*] Fixed a bug where some stats would save when killed.
[*] Fixed a bug where setting sliders in the settings menu to their default value would not display the reset button as disabled.
[*] Fixed a bug where vines would collide with the cart.
[*] Fixed a bug where bark would collide with the cart.
[*] Fixed a bug where there would be no water SFX when walking in shallow water in some rivers.

[*] Fixed a bug where a warning to “place wood” into the campfire would appear even if the campfire was lit.
[*] Fixed a bug where when teleporting to certain locations with the cheat window, the player would get stuck in the ground or fall under the map.
[*] Fixed a bug where rabbit traps would be invisible, but the traps would still make sound of a trapped animal.
[*] Fixed a bug where weather was not affected by the volume slider.

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.content:
[u][b]Road Ahead[/b][/u]

What can you expect to see in the near future?

For starters, the other side of the island is still not near complete. Nor is it near the end of the block out stage. To save the trouble of possibly redoing some things in the future, I will move the focus over from greyboxing to programming the rest of the story events to make sure that it coexists properly with the current layout. Changes will most likely occur.

And while this is going on, I would also like to put some focus into improving current features that is open for all players (including those who do not wish to seek out the other side through cheats). I'm not an experienced developer and I will admit when I make mistakes so that hopefully other aspiring devs out there can learn from my faults:

1. Retexturing (quality of life addition - not prioritized)

When I started development, I had vaguely heard about the term "trimsheet". Back then it seemed intimidating, I admit, but I recently revisited the technique and realized why its so often used in the industry. Not only does it improve performance, it also makes for efficient modeling and texturing of new assets, and it can help provide players with a higher quality visuals without a major performance hit. I can see several cases where I would be able to use it, for instance the wooden building structures. In addition to the performance fixes, the structures will also be adjusted to appear more seamless.

This won't be a priority, more of a side, quality of life addition. 

2. Redeveloping systems (AI focused - Priority)

This sounds rather heavy, but I think its also necessary.

Because the current AI system is...[u]rough[/u].

Up to this point, I have used assets from the Unreal Engine Marketplace to create the foundation for this game. Two of the biggest ones being the inventory system (which also includes parts of the building system) and the AI system.

I want to make it perfectly clear that the assets I have used, are not being redeveloped because they are bad assets. They are great assets that I would recommend to anyone starting out. I have been able to pick apart the code and use these assets as a training ground. They have been my training wheels, and I think it's time to take them off so that this game can shine in its own way.

As most of you have probably experienced, there have been issues with buggy AI, and still to this day I have seen some reoccuring issues. These issues have appeared due to my inexperience and my own tweaking of the marketplace assets. I have spent a lot of time trying to solve the issues by digging into the asset, (trying to fix the issue and creating two more issues down the road), and I have come to realize that for the next stage of the story, it would be more beneficial if I create the AI system from scratch. Not only that, but it will be less time consuming and will be easier to debug and add new features to the game.

And while this sounds like it would require a lot of time, I see it differently: a lot of the code that is  visible in the game are basic AI functions, and a lot of the self-created code includes work arounds for the marketplace asset so that they can work together without issues. In other words, disconnecting my work from the marketplace asset shouldn't be as problematic as it sounds.

As I'm writing this devlog, I have already converted half of the old system into a new one. There's still a lot of bug testing to do, but also some minor changes that I hope to share with you soon.

As always, I would love to hear your thoughts. If there are any features you are missing, or would like to see improved, don't hesitate to reach out in the forums or via the [url=https://discord.com/invite/rVwsQfVNBV] official discord [/url]server. And if there are any AI related features you wish would be improved or added, I'd love to hear your thoughts!

Until next devlog!

- Skylene, Developer

notes.title: Patch Notes [BU35/0.6.5]
notes.content:
Hello Players!

This new patch is a minor update with the focus on improving different gameplay features, turning legacy movement into the new unreal engine enhanced system and UI changes!

In regards to the new input system, there has been a change to the use of the Interaction Key F. Previously, placing resources on structures would use Input E (default) and collecting resources would use Input F (default). The new changes in this patch now lets you place AND collect with the use of Input E (default). To help remember this, the UI has also been changed temporarily to 2D where it showcases which key to use for different interactions as shown in the example below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339493/e819daf232d2ad874c7845a518f8aaa624ac64a7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339493/2dd3bb8e0a517114e04f4970297d8bf4703e02b6.png[/img]

This patch also involves changes in the highlighted object system. Previously, the whole cart, resource racks and campfire would be highlighted for interaction, and while that worked well for the cart and resource racks, it did no favors for the campfire that was equipped with a Kettle. Resources in carts and on the resource racks and the Kettle are now individually highlighted when hovered and display their own interaction UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339493/b0d7093746f171a0d40ba69cad8c931fe0ebff86.png[/img]
As usual, you can find the full Update Overview below. The next updates will have focus on a new and improved AI system, building modularity, shader optimization and story advancements.

[u][b]Overview:[/b][/u]

[u][b]New[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added save thumbnails.
[*] Added a new logo.
[*] Added a new main menu screen.
[*] Added a new settings option to set the quality of materials.
[*] Added highlight to the fur when hovered on the fur rack.
[*] Added highlight to the cooking pot when hovered.
[/list]
[u][b]Changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the running sound effects.
[*] Cagedoor no longer opens automatically when breaking the lock.
[*] Changed from legacy input to enhanced input.
[*] Changed the options for adjusting inverted mouse.
[*] Collecting from the fur rack now uses the Primary Interaction keybind (default = E)
[*] Collecting from the resource rack now uses the Primary Interaction keybind (default = E)
[*] Collecting from the cart now uses the Primary Interaction keybind (default = E)
[*] Collecting from the kettle now uses the Primary Interaction keybind (default = E)
[*] Interacting with a campfire while holding a beverage, now only fills the pot if its highlighted. If not, it attempts to set the beverage down on its own.
[*] If reload button is held, player now has to hover and click to select the new arrow type.
[*] Increased climbing speed.
[*] Interacting with a bed and falling asleep will now leave the player asleep for a random amount of hours.
[*] Increased daylight length by 2 hours (sun sets 8PM, not 6PM).
[*] Increased cage door open and close speed from 5 to 2 seconds.
[*] To climb ladder, players now have to press a key (default = spacebar)
[*] Removed a hole in a cliffside that would leave players stuck.
[*] Removed Sleeping UI.
[/list]
[u][b]Fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where some environment shaders would have stretching when close to the landscape.
[*] Fixed a bug where the arrow UI would disappear instantly.
[*] Fixed a bug where motion blur settings would not save.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player would suddenly stop climbing and fall off the ladder.
[*] Fixed jittery movement while climbing.
[*] Fixed a bug where log wall 2 and 4 had the wrong structure.
[*] Fixed a bug where changing FOV did nothing.
[*] Fixed a bug where turning on motion blur had no effect.
[*] Fixed a bug where the campfire did not display any firewood if it was burning when the save was created.
[*] Fixed a bug where idle camera shake was unaffected by the camera shake settings.
[*] Fixed a bug where campfire and torch light would disappear when not looked directly at.
[*] Fixed a bug where the warning message, when trying to add more fur to the fur rack while its occupied, was not translated.
[*] Fixed a bug where the building tip widget was stuck on the screen while building mode was disabled.
[*] Fixed a bug where the metal cages would cause the game severe FPS drop when loading a save.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could not destroy the cart.
[*] Fixed a bug where medium rocks could not be stores in the cart.
[*] Fixed a bug where harvesting sounds were unaffected by volume settings.
[*] Fixed a bug where there was no sound when picking up resources from the cart.
[*] Fixed a bug where resources would not visibly stack in hands when collecting from cart, sawhorses or resource racks.
[*] Fixed a bug where when collecting from the sawhorses, it would collect the bottom resource first.
[*] Fixed a bug where respawning by selecting "Last Save" On death did not load the previous save and left the player permanently dead.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes [BU34/0.6.4]
notes.content:
Hey players!

This patch brings about a new cooking system and a set of tutorials regarding the gameplay. There are also several changes to the UI and two new cheat commands.

Before we jump into the update, I want to introduce to you a new cheat feature. "Godmode" will allow players, if manually enabled, to roam any aspect of the world. This has been added to give players the option to view new additions as they are under development. In other words, these areas are not available though non-cheated gameplay, so if you want to wait for the full release of the gameplay you simply have to do nothing but wait.

Back to this update, lets take a look at the new cooking system:

To access this new feature in old saves, you will have to remove the already built campfire and build a new one. This has been added as a feature to make sure that anyone who has any items in the old campfire system will not lose the progress.

The biggest change is the removal of the 2D cooking UI. 

To fuel the campfire, you need to hold a flamable item. Items that effect the burning time of the campfire, will have new added information to the item details. These items are [u]bark, stick, leaf, vines and cloth.[/u] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339493/8c530abe24b8a223ead140bedc6e7558536ec402.png[/img]
To cook, simply hold the raw food or beverage in your hand and interact with the campfire to place it down. To collect it again, look at the item you wish to collect and once highlighted, interact with it to pick it up again.

Along with a new system, there are two new items that can help improve cooking. 

A kettle that lets you cook more liquid at once.
A grill that will keep the food from instantly burning. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339493/9ba91b2806d0e4b6e95e0b0f7c32a9b93b45f1ef.png[/img]
Of course, if food is left too long over the fire, it will eventually burn.

For more information and visual examples, make sure that "Show tips" is enabled in the settings and walk up to the newly built campfire for a tutorial.

Tutorials and tips can be turned off and on at any time in the settings. And you don't have to start a new game for the tutorials to appear. Simply walk up to a building such as campfires, sawhorses and racks and the tutorial for it will appear. In addition to this. interaction UI to the respective buildings has been removed. 

The feature is still in testing phases, so any feedback is always appreciated! If there is anything you are missing, wish was not removed or adjusted, don't hesitate to reach out. Everything is always evaluated!

I hope you enjoy the patch and its new features, changes and fixes.

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

At the start of the launch, I wanted to get into the habit of writing a monthly sneak peak to the community. However, I haven't been true to that in fear of giving false expectations and under-delivering content. Over the past few months, I have seen how that has had an effect on the community, and therefore I want to try again. Starting today with devlog #1.

It's been a few months since the previous patch, and I wanted to focus this one on making the game more immersive. 

I always felt like the game lacked some sort of spirit, and it always pointed back towards the animations and interactions (and the animal behaviors, but I'll mention that in a moment). Therefore, for this patch, I have spent time turning the game from a "first person" game, to a "true first person" game.

This might not seem like a big deal to some, and some of you may ask "did the developer just spent all this time on that?". Partially. Yes I did.

True first person opens up different posibilities. I added this feature for two main reasons:
1. You can finally see the character's lower body, which makes you no longer a strange soaring entity with just hands and a weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339493/f320a00cfce1b5d20d30f69869d1361e32fc8ea7.png[/img]
(This is not the final product. Changes can occur)

2. Animations feel less stiff, as the camera is attached to the actual character. This makes the camera movement follow head animations. An example is if the character crouches down, the camera will move down with the body whereas previously it would stay still during the whole animation.

This feature could in some cases, increase the risk of motion sickness, as walking, jumping, running, etc. would make the camera shaking. However, I have recreated a lot (almost all) of the animations to prevent that, and so if you wish for the extra camera shake, you can still toggle it on and off in the settings.

[u][b]AI Update[/b][/u]

As mentioned above, I also found the animal behaviors to lack some life. It has been intentional to have the animals act different than they do in real life, but as of now, they either flee, attack or walk around in circles.

Therefore, this update includes a slight behavior patch. Tamed animals that are set to "stay" will now interact with foodbowls and beds that the player builds. If this feature goes well, I also have a few other additions in mind, so I can't wait to hear your feedback!

I also have an addition for the people who would like to play the Foe path. Aside from getting new harvesting animations, you can also expect to see new decorations such as fur decorations, wall thropies, fences (or barricades if you would prefer that word) and a new "crafting" method for treating fur.

Friendly and Foe players will both be able to decorate their homes with new furniture, a new fireplace, a new resource addition and other wall decorations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339493/38f3c54f8bfa0f162216550068bc7ded7b3e5d56.png[/img]
(This is not the final product. Changes can occur)

While this update was supposed to come out sooner, I did feel like it wasn't ready for release. Since the new patch will include fur and head thropies, I figured I would redo the design for the animals now so that I don't have to redo them (and the fur and thropies) as well at a later time. Below is a progress shot of the new deer:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43339493/4b588547eb089fe0f90e0e9511fcff4e5277cc90.png[/img]
(This is not the final product. Changes can occur)

1. You can finally see the character's lower body, which makes you no longer a strange soaring entity with just hands and a weapon.

Animations feel less stiff, as the camera is attached to the actual character. This makes the camera movement follow head animations. An example is if the character crouches down, the camera will move down with the body whereas previously it would stay still during the whole animation.
Tamed animals that are set to "stay" will now interact with foodbowls and beds that the player builds.

Aside from getting new harvesting animations, you can also expect to see new decorations such as fur decorations, wall thropies, fences (or barricades if you would prefer that word) and a new "crafting" method for treating fur.
Friendly and Foe players will both be able to decorate their homes with new furniture, a new fireplace, a new resource addition and other wall decorations.

notes.title: Patch Notes [BU30]
notes.content:
Hello players!

Another update is now out that features more explorable options, and also a few reworks of already explorable POIs. It also includes a world map that can be accessed from the start, and an added cheat window for those who would like to play in a creative building mode.

Some of the POIs are still under development, but I have choosen to release them in this update to allow you to test it out and provide feedback for improvements.

This update also contains some optimization features, including the decision to not use Lumen as the default rendering mode anymore, as it doesnt seem necessary for this project. 

As always, I hope you like the update, and I would love to hear what you think of the new additions and changes.

Below is a full overview of the new additions:

[u][b]New[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added a cheat window. ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1948140/discussions/0/3800526395810701214/]List[/url] of cheats)
[*] Added a world map that can be accessed from the start by pressing (M).
[*] Added console commands for teleportation and spawning items.
[*] Added a new harvest animation for rabbits.
[*] Added a new harvest animation for the other animals.
[*] Added a new research site.
[*] Added a wolf nest. (Work in progress)
[*] Added two new story notes.
[*] Added lanterns.
[*] Added two new achievements.
[*] Added weather.
[*] Added fireflies effects.
[*] Added more blood decals on the weapons and player hands when hurting or harvesting animals.
[/list]

[u][b]POI changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Reworked the treehouses.
[*] Changed the area around the waterfall.
[*] Removed building blocked zones.
[*] Relocated the discoverable hatchet.
[/list]

[u][b]Visual Changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Adjusted and fixed a couple of animations.
[*] Adjusted the visuals of several shaders and effects.
[*] Adjusted the landscape shader.
[*] Adjusted the darkness of shadows.
[*] Adjusted the blueprint shader to make it more visible.
[*] Lumen is no longer being used as the default global illumination mode to optimize performance.
[/list]

[u][b]AI Changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the frequency of rabbit sounds from trapped rabbits.
[*] Changed the peripheral vision angle from 90 degrees to 45 degrees.
[*] Changed the sight radius from 1500 to 1000.
[*] Wolves no longer spawn once the nest has been cleared.
[*] Replaced one of the spawners with foxes instead of wolves.
[*] Wolf health changed from 200 to 350.

[*] Adjusted hit trace of wolves to give more accuracy.

[*] Default screen mode changed from fullscreen to borderless.
[*] Changed from DX12 to DX11

[*] Made changes to how trees are saved and loaded.
[*] The icon over the campfire now only appears on the map.
[/list]

[*] Fixed a bug where players could not set the tamed animals name.
[*] Fixed a bug where the ai name was slightly offset to the left.
[*] Fixed a bug where only one wolf would howl when spotting player.
[*] Fixed a bug where there would be no water footstep sounds when passing through the pumpkin river.
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing “default” button in the settings menu didn’t work as intended.

[*] Fixed a shading issue with the interactable boulders.
[*] Fixed a bug where the toolbar would disappear when destroying buildings.
[*] Fixed a bug where the toolbar would disappear when pressing the inventory button while the building tab was open.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could only get to 499 rocks in the 500 rocks achievement.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could not build a campfire.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would freeze for some players when getting close to the treehouses.
[*] Fixed a bug where the howling audio would keep playing when wolves took damage mid-howl.
[*] Fixed a bug where sticks could not be used in campfires.

notes.title: Patch Notes [BU27] Part 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In this first part of the UI update, there have been some changes to the UI and lore for the game.

[u]The major changes include[/u]

[list]
[*] German translation
[*] French translation
[*] Norwegian translation
[*] A book that stores notes, the to-do list and reputation
[*] Visual update for the interface
[*] New main menu and loading screen
[*] New interaction UI
[*] Updated notes lore
[/list]

If there is anything that you notice could be translated better, or differently, then don’t hesitate to let me know via the forums.

[u][b]Important side note:[/b][/u]

If you are playing on a save file from when the game launched, or from the latest update, I would recommend that you create a new save file to prevent a sudden corruption of the file that has been a result of some of the old code being stuck in the save files. You can still play on your old saves, but you might experience a sudden data-loss.

As always, let me know what you think of the changes and new additions!

Below is a full list of the update.

[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a German translation.

[*] Added a hover highlight for crafting slots.
[*] Added a visual of the current game version in the main menu.
[*] Added a crafting sound for when successfully crafting an item.
[*] Added a FOV settings option.
[*] Added a slight scrolling delay to ensure the correct item in the toolbelt is chosen and highlighted.
[*] Added player stats to the notebook to display how animals have been treated.
[/list]

[*] Increased the size of the rabbit traps slightly.
[*] Changed the text on several story notes.
[*] Changed the sound effects for to-do and journal notifications.
[*] Changed the name ice pickaxe > forgotten pickaxe.
[*] Moved the tunnel note location to the front of the cave.
[*] Adjusted the empty can icon.
[*] Changed some descriptions on some items.
[*] Made some improvements to the loading screen and time, to avoid sudden crashes.
[*] Temporarily removed the “M” keybind for map until some issues have been resolved.
[*] Removed the text from the journal regarding the character’s experience roaming the island to allow players freedom for their imagination.
[*] Removed the map note.
[*] Removed the note about the sawhorse.
[/list]

[b]UI Changes[/b]

[*] Changed the oxygen UI.
[*] Changed the player stats UI.
[*] Changed the Main Menu UI.
[*] Changed the loading screen UI.
[*] Changed the arrow selection UI.
[*] Lowered the opacity on the quickslot from 1.0 to 0.7
[*] Notes moved to the new notebook.
[*] Journal section moved to the new notebook and is now under “To-do list”.
[*] Added a new interaction UI.
[*] Interaction icon now shows up whenever the player is near an item, and not just when looking directly at it.
[*] Changed the UI that appears when interacting with tamed animals.
[*] Character Stats are now hidden when opening the inventory.
[*] Added a new settings tabbed called “Gameplay”.
[*] Moved Camera Shake from graphics to gameplay in the settings menu.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]

[*] Fixed a bug where some rabbit traps would be bigger than  others.

[*] Fixed a bug where certain buildable tools could not be deleted.
[*] Fixed a collision issue on the plank sawhorse.
[*] Fixed a bug where the cart would get stuck on different items.
[/list]

Hello Players!

A new update for you to start off the weekend. The update is more focused on improving the gameplay for foe players. One example is that injured animals will now leave a trail of blood that will make it easier to find what direction they ran to. But to also make the game a little more challenging/fighting based for those who love hunting, the nature will start to punish you for taking the foe path. So you better be ready when the wolves start howling!

Theres also been added a feature, to make exploring more peaceful for players who prefer it that way. Wolves and boars will no longer chase you into the ocean, or across the map, and will instead give up chasing you after enough time has passed. However, if you do run into a pack of wolves, you will be now be warned before they start to attack.

Let me know what you think of the changes/new additions!

With that said, I wish you all a great weekend!

[*] Injured animals now leave a blood trail as they run away.
[*] Hitting animals with weapons will now leave a blood effect on the animal.
[*] Wolves now howl as a warning before they attack the player.
[*] Spears now require 4 sticks.
[*] Crafted Hatchet and Crafted Pickaxe now require 3 sticks.
[*] Added a feature where boars and wolves will not leave further than a set radius from where they roam to prevent players from always being chased.
[*] Wolves will now appear every now and then to attack the player if the friendly bar is too far to the left.

[*] Fixed a bug where building requirement UI would show when looking at the ladders in the treehouses.

notes.title: Friend Or Foe Patch Notes [BU11]
notes.content:
Hello Players!

A bigger update today to help improve the use of the bow as a weapon. There have been changes/improvements to how far arrows fly, how much damage each arrow makes and there is also now a bleed effect that takes place when damaging animals that will ensure a wounded animal’s death. What bow you are using will also affect the base damage, bleed damage per second, how far arrows travel and at what speed the arrow travels. 

To help players understand better if they hit their target, a hit-sound will now only play when the arrows hit the target, and leave no sound if missed.

Injuring an animal will cause a bleed effect to trigger every second. Damage triggered depends on what weapon and what arrow is used. If an animal is already injured, the damage taken by the following hit will be increased by 30 damage.

[*] Fixed a bug where notes would not save
[/list]

[b]Optimization[/b]

Adjusted the way that built structures break to optimize performance. 

[b]Additional Info[/b]

If you experience with this patch that there are stones, sticks and leaves that cannot be used to craft or build structures, or won’t stack, then this is not a bug. Unfortunately, to fix some issues and prevent other issues from happening in the future, the item ID of these items had to be adjusted.

Nothing else should be affected though, and if it is, please report it via the forums or [url=https://discord.gg/rVwsQfVNBV]discord[/url]

Aside from that, I want to say a thank you to the community for taking time to help Friend or Foe improve. I have lots of exciting things to develop once more bugs have been addressed, and I  can't wait to share it with you!

- Skylene, Stylized Indie Games

- Fixed a bug where pressing “default” button in the settings menu would set the settings to high, not epic.
- Fixed a bug where the pause menu would not focus until player clicked on the screen once.
- Fixed a bug where bushes would disappear if picking up something near it.

notes.title: Friend Or Foe Patch notes(BU01)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you so much for your patience. There have been some issues with the launch, and more so with how the trees are not as predictable as they should have been. This update should secure a much more improved version of the trees, that will ensure that you can cut them down without any issues.

If you are encountering any issues when loading up the game, such as there being no trees at all, this will be because the game has not registered that a tree has been cut, and that will unfortunately mean that you have to make a new game.

However, for players that have been cutting down trees before the patch, you shouldnt have any issues.

I apologize again deeply for the issues that have occured and I hope that this new update will finally make it easier for players to enjoy the game.

Bug fixes:

- Fixed a bug where trees would not cut properly
- Fixed a bug where cutting bushes would make player unable to pick up anything afterwards
- Fixed a bug where picking up a bow would delete the landscape
